name: Strive, Inc.
summary: Strive, Inc. provides investment advisory and structured finance services. The company operates through three segments: Asset Management, Medical Device, and Corporate and Other. The Asset Management segment provides investment advisory services and acts as sub-advisor to a series of exchange-traded funds, with products offered through exchange-traded funds and separate accounts. The Medical Device segment sells medical devices, generating revenue from software licensing, fee-per-test arrangements, and hardware sales.
